dependencyPolicies.workaroundPolicy: bounded, receipt-owned, version-gated, and never applied to generated runtime caches
dependencyPolicies.retestPolicy: weekly, on observed release, and before managed upgrade
dependencyPolicies.removalProof: released artifact passes the host-neutral hook and lifecycle conformance suite

dependencyPolicies.workaroundPolicy: qualify evidence honestly; no simulated QE verdict and no provider-backed fallback without authorization
dependencyPolicies.retestPolicy: weekly, on observed release, and before managed upgrade
dependencyPolicies.removalProof: released host-neutral runner passes participant and provider conformance

dependencyPolicies.workaroundPolicy: retain source-grounded read-only evidence; never patch versioned cache copies as authoritative source
dependencyPolicies.retestPolicy: on brain update, observed release, and before managed upgrade
dependencyPolicies.removalProof: updated brain passes doctor plus exact source-reference conformance

dependencyPolicies.workaroundPolicy: use isolated state and bounded migration gates; never reinterpret store health as authorization
dependencyPolicies.retestPolicy: on store migration, observed release, and before managed upgrade
dependencyPolicies.removalProof: released artifact passes store integrity and migration conformance

dependencyPolicies.workaroundPolicy: subscription execution stays default; separately billed provider routing requires explicit opt-in
dependencyPolicies.retestPolicy: on routing-policy change, observed release, and before managed upgrade
dependencyPolicies.removalProof: released router passes authorization and routing conformance

constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus local host conformance failure
constraints.strategy: retain the last proven version and re-run host conformance before removing the block
constraints.versionGate: apply only when the installed version exactly matches an affected entry
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: an upstream release closes the issue and passes agentic-kit's host-neutral hook and lifecycle conformance suite

constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus local capability evidence
constraints.strategy: keep agentic-kit detection read-only and treat registration, health, reachability, and authorization as separate facts
constraints.versionGate: treat every 3.x version as observation-only until independently verified
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: upstream exposes the required evidence and agentic-kit verifies it against a released artifact

constraints.primaryEvidence: upstream issue plus live participant/provider transport tests
constraints.strategy: qualify external-provider and cross-host results as transport evidence rather than a host-neutral QE verdict
constraints.versionGate: applies to 3.x until a released host-neutral runner is proven
constraints.expiryPolicy: retest within 14 days; do not silently extend stale evidence
constraints.sunsetWhen: a released host-neutral runner passes the live participant and provider conformance tests
